newsitem.title: USA: Roberts gets FDA OK to market Agrylin.
newsitem.headline: Roberts gets FDA OK to market Agrylin.

text.p: Roberts Pharmaceutical Corp said Monday that the Food and Drug Administration has approved AGRYLIN for U.S. marketing, and the company expects to begin shipping within 10 days.
AGRYLIN is the first drug approved by the FDA for the treatment of essential thrombocythemia, a life-threatening condition characterized by elevated blood platelet counts, Roberts said.
This condition results in an abnormally high incidence of adverse events associated with thrombosis (blood clotting), including heart attack and stroke, the company said.
